description: Cluster label carrying a double quote and a backslash. The selector must escape the backslash FIRST and then the quote, and the wait_event_type regex keeps its two backslashes so PromQL's string parser leaves a literal-asterisk regex. A single backslash there is rejected by the store with 'unknown escape sequence U+002A'. The recorded response keys are the exact query text, so any change to the escaping fails this fixture.
